title: OpenSSF Scorecard (supply-chain health)
summary: Scheduled OpenSSF Scorecard run scoring this repo's supply-chain posture (branch protection, signed releases, token permissions, dangerous workflows, maintenance) and gating on a minimum aggregate score.
notes: Runs the pinned ossf/scorecard-action against THIS repo (repo mode) and fails when the aggregate score drops below SCORECARD_MIN_SCORE (0-10). Complementary to `agentsec audit`'s ScorecardRunner (same tool, run locally at `--network tier1`) and to the static `actions-sha-pin`/`actions-script-injection`/`ci-secret-env-unscoped` guards: the value here is the API-only health signals (Branch-Protection, Maintained, Signed-Releases, Fuzzing) that CVE scanners and static guards can't see. Uses the automatic `${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}`; for full Branch-Protection coverage on some repos, supply a fine-grained PAT as a `SCORECARD_TOKEN` secret and swap it into the `repo_token:` line. Results are uploaded as a build artifact only (no code-scanning/SARIF upload), so no GitHub Advanced Security is required. `publish_results` is off by default; enable it (public repos only, needs `id-token: write`) to earn the OpenSSF badge.
